title: Linear Bandits on Ellipsoids: Minimax Optimal Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2502.17175v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider linear stochastic bandits where the set of actions is an ellipsoid. We provide the first known minimax optimal algorithm for this problem. We first derive a novel information-theoretic lower bound on the regret of any algorithm, which must be at least $\Omega(\min(d \sigma \sqrt{T} + d \|\theta\|_{A}, \|\theta\|_{A} T))$ where $d$ is the dimension, $T$ the time horizon, $\sigma^2$ the noise variance, $A$ a matrix defining the set of actions and $\theta$ the vector of unknown parameters. We then provide an algorithm whose regret matches this bound to a multiplicative universal constant. The algorithm is non-classical in the sense that it is not optimistic, and it is not a sampling algorithm. The main idea is to combine a novel sequential procedure to estimate $\|\theta\|$, followed by an explore-and-commit strategy informed by this estimate. translated_title: 椭球上的线性老虎机：极小极大最优算法
translated_abstract: 我们考虑动作集为椭球体的线性随机老虎机问题。我们提供了该问题的首个已知的极小极大最优算法。我们首先推导出任意算法遗憾值的新型信息论下界，该下界必须至少为 $\Omega(\min(d \sigma \sqrt{T} + d \|\theta\|_{A}, \|\theta\|_{A} T))$，其中 $d$ 是维度，$T$ 是时间范围，$\sigma^2$ 是噪声方差，$A$ 是定义动作集的矩阵，$\theta$ 是未知参数向量。然后我们提供了一种算法，其遗憾值与该下界在一个乘性通用常数范围内匹配。该算法是非经典的，因为它既不是乐观算法，也不是采样算法。其主要思想是结合一种新颖的顺序过程来估计 $\|\theta\|$，随后采用基于该估计的探索-承诺策略。该算法具有很高的计算效率，一次运行仅需时间 $O$……
tldr: 本文针对动作集为椭球体的线性随机老虎机问题，首次提出极小极大最优算法，通过推导新型信息论遗憾下界，并设计一种结合参数范数估计与探索-承诺策略的非经典（非乐观、非采样）高效算法来实现与该下界匹配。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first minimax optimal algorithm for linear stochastic bandits on ellipsoids, deriving a novel information-theoretic regret lower bound and designing a non-classical, computationally efficient algorithm that combines a sequential procedure for estimating $\|\theta\|$ with an explore-and-commit strategy to match this bound.
